newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares slip in sluggish trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares slip in sluggish trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares slipped on Wednesday and trade remained sluggish at the country's bourse, dealers said.
The group A index fell 33.86 points to 2,343.66 in dull central market trade of just over 900,000 litas.
Dealers say that activity probably will not pick up until after a spate of shareholders' meetings next month.
Fourteen of the 39 A group shares fell while 17 remained unchanged. Only eight edged up.
Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company dropped almost ten percent to 6.58 litas in trade of 106,000 litas.
Pharmaceutical maker Sanitas fell 7.39 percent to 82.60 litas in trade of 65,500 litas.
Kaunas Milk also suffered a big set-back, slipping 9.09 percent to 3.90 litas in trade worth 15,320 litas.
Hermis Bank, one of the leading commercial banks, dipped by 0.55 percent to 198.90 litas in turnover of 4,770 litas.
Gainers included Birzai Dairy, which rose to 9.00 litas from 8.80 litas. Over 29,000 litas worth of its shares swapped hands.
Block trades worth 766,000 litas were also made and the secondary T-bill market reached 2.29 million litas.
